title: Acceptance from a Halted Configuration
statement: For any nondeterministic register program, oracle, input, register assignment $v$, and optional recorded Boolean answer $res$, the halted configuration with registers $v$ and answer $res$ is accepting if and only if $res$ is true.
hypotheses_covered: A nondeterministic register program, oracle, and input are fixed
